```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
source("config.R")
```

## User inputs

Use the same range and omitted standards as in `Standard-Checking.qmd`.

```{r}
plate <- "Plates/Nitrite/MMDDYYYY_nitrite_1.csv"
high_range <- FALSE
bad_standards <- integer(0)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv(plate, check.names = FALSE)
conc_vector <- if (high_range) N_HIGH else N_LOW

standards <- raw_data %>%
  select(2:4) %>%
  setNames(c("Rep_1", "Rep_2", "Rep_3")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric),
         Standard_Level = row_number(),
         Concentration = conc_vector[Standard_Level],
         Flagged = Standard_Level %in% bad_standards) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Rep_1, Rep_2, Rep_3),
               names_to = "Replication",
               values_to = "Absorbance") %>%
  drop_na(Absorbance) %>%
  filter(!Flagged)

fit_model <- lm(Absorbance ~ Concentration, data = standards)
slope <- coef(fit_model)[["Concentration"]]
intercept <- coef(fit_model)[["(Intercept)"]]
```

```{r}
is_nitrite <- grepl("nitrite", plate, ignore.case = TRUE)
key_path <- if (is_nitrite) NITRITE_KEY_PATH else NITRATE_KEY_PATH

file_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(plate))
name_parts <- str_split(file_base, "_")[[1]]
if (length(name_parts) != 3) {
  stop("Plate filename must be MMDDYYYY_nutrient_replication.csv.")
}

key_sheet_name <- paste0(name_parts[1], "_", name_parts[3])
target_out_dir <- file.path(
  "Concentrations",
  if (is_nitrite) "Nitrite" else "Nitrate"
)
output_path <- file.path(target_out_dir, paste0(file_base, ".csv"))

plate_long <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(Row = LETTERS[seq_len(n())]) %>%
  select(Row, matches("^X?[0-9]+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Row, names_to = "Column", values_to = "Absorbance") %>%
  mutate(
    Column = as.integer(str_extract(Column, "[0-9]+")),
    Concentration = (Absorbance - intercept) / slope
  )

key_raw <- read_excel(key_path, sheet = key_sheet_name, .name_repair = "minimal")
colnames(key_raw)[1] <- "Row"
key_long <- key_raw %>%
  select(Row, matches("^[0-9]+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Row, names_to = "Column", values_to = "Sample_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Column = as.integer(Column),
    Sample_ID = na_if(str_trim(Sample_ID), "")
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Sample_ID)

final_well_data <- inner_join(key_long, plate_long, by = c("Row", "Column")) %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
  mutate(Replication = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Replication, Row, Column, Absorbance, Concentration)

dir.create(target_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(final_well_data, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved:", output_path, "\n")
```
